answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment for validator status, ensuring identity costs are tied to economic value rather than a relic of computational effort. Like sedimentary shale hardening under pressure, network security grows robust through financial skin-in-the-game. If an attacker attempts to spawn violet-coded malicious nodes, they face punitive slashing, effectively rendering the cost of identity replication greater than the potential gain.
